{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent negative sentiment (e.g., sentiment < 0.0) by 5-15% of the forecasted peak.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is positive (e.g., sentiment > 0.3) and price is trending downward.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts — lag correction: if sentiment changes by >0.5 in 1-2 days, adjust forecast 1-3 days later.",
    "For long-term forecasts (30d), reduce volatility by 10-25% if sentiment is flat or negative over 5+ days.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3+ consecutive days), apply downward bias of 5-10% to next forecast."
  ]
}
